## S3a and S9/QBA scope

S3a contains 25 primary analytical strata. S9 contains 96 target-specific coverage cells across 24 comparator arms; Boisdron-Celle is excluded.
QBA uses the primary median OR lookup with its 95% CrI recorded in `qba_primary_or_cri_lookup.csv`; the expected-carrier arithmetic remains a screening calculation.

## Source eligibility

The source eligibility table lists primary strata and the excluded overlapping cohort.

## Provenance

`provenance_input_checksums.csv` records the immutable manifest, reference core reports, primary input, source classifications.
